4125-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4125-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4419-4694-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

803-5315-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5315-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-1753-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist or the creature with undying

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

5326-8095--5--6.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

152-6252-7824.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-6252-7824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2034-4013-4690.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two basic lands.
2034-4013-4690.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Phylath.
When Phylath enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-3532-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

1806-2060-6797-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2376-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

647-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1402-2292-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1247-5832-7176.notablePrerequisites: Joraga Treespeaker has at least five level counters on it..
1247-5832-7176.description:
Cause Pili-Pala to become an Elf using Oko.
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2448-5220-6900-7192.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2999-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4766-6797-6990.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song
attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-4222-5268.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

3693-4613-5872-6843.description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by 1.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Taii Wakeen.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2292-4871-5921.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

950-1432--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
950-1432--80.description:
If Fatestitcher is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Fatestitcher to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher and another legendary creature.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

225-565-1987-2187.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-2187.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Possessed Skaab.
When the land and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, Possessed Skaab and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-2187.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

2061-4477-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-4477-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1399-2800-3814.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1399-2800-3814.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the land tapped in step 1 and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.

1742-2051-2546-3178.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1742-2051-2546-3178.description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1849-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1849-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

3196-4846.description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying {3}{B}.
Last Voyage of the _____ enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Last Voyage of the _____ to it.
Worldgorger Dragon triggers.
Resolve Worldgorger Dragon's ability, exiling all other permanents you control.
Last Voyage of the _____'s last ability triggers, sacrificing Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1670-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Pulsemage Advocate.
Pulsemage Advocate does not have summoning sickness.
 You control a nontoken creature with power three or greater.
1636-1670-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with power three or greater, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Pulsemage Advocate by tapping it and putting three cards from an opponent's graveyard into their owner's hand, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

813-1181-1854.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying {3}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Makeshift Mannequin from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2034-2397-2493-2588.description:
Cast Agadeem's Awakening paying {4}{B}{B}{B} returning Priest of Gix and Archaeomancer to the battlefield.
Priest of Gix enters, adding six {B}.
Archaeomancer enters, return Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Priest of Gix and Archaeomancer to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
